reviews.text:
Friendly and professional service for our furry friends.
I recommend it.

The mere fact that the Google Maps listing says it's open, then you drive 15km and it's closed, might make it the best in the country, but it's still misleading. The other options mention lunchtime. At least you can count on that. Good for those who think misleading advertising is good. If you lie about something so simple, I don't know where you'll tell the truth.

I called to confirm the price for a kitten's first vaccination, and I was told it would be €20. In the end, they charged me €57.
In addition, I had a booster scheduled about a month in advance, and a few days before, they called me asking me to go to the hospital to get the vaccine because the veterinarian would be on leave and wouldn't have many available appointments. When I said I would schedule it at another clinic, they arranged a new time. They were supposed to confirm, but they never called back. Because of the lack of consideration and professionalism, I looked for another clinic.
I used to treat my other animals at this clinic, but now I won't go back. It left a terrible impression.
Over the past year, each time we had a consultation with our dogs, the professional team was different. It's impossible to maintain quality of service without continuity in treatment. …
